recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5863 unless a future work group decision changes Bundle reference-resolution semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5863 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core correction for references section 1.16.0.2. It reported that Bundle reference-resolution text still told applications to match either entry.id or entry.link[self], even though those were not the correct Bundle entry identity elements for that purpose.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in commit 5544902951a4fe943445361593076ae8a3361dc5, '#5863 - fix old text in references', which removed entry.link[self] from source/references.html and clarified that matching was based on full URLs by prepending the entry base.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini. The current references page now says Bundle-relative references use the base URL implied by Bundle.entry.fullUrl and links to the Bundle resolving section. The detailed current algorithm in source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml resolves references by matching Bundle.entry.fullUrl and, for versioned references, resource.meta.versionId. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant discussion or minutes that would change this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already avoids the stale entry.id/entry.link[self] instruction and conveys the modern Bundle.entry.fullUrl-based resolution rule.
